साउथ सुपरस्टार Dhanush बॉक्स ऑफिस पर एक नया रिकॉर्ड बनाने के लिए बिल्कुल तैयार हैं! 🎬

20 November को सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज़ हो रही फिल्म OM के साथ धनुष post-COVID दौर में 1000 crore club में शामिल होने की तरफ कदम बढ़ा रहे हैं। Rajkumar Periasamy के डायरेक्शन और Mammootty के साथ वाली इस फिल्म को लेकर pre-release phase में काफी जबरदस्त बज बना हुआ है।

रिपोर्ट्स के मुताबिक post-COVID दौर में धनुष की 9 फिल्मों ने मिलकर दुनिया भर में कुल 930.14 crore gross कलेक्शन किया है। इसमें उनकी फिल्म Tere Ishk Mein ने सबसे ज्यादा 164 crore की कमाई की थी। अब 1000 crore का जादुई आंकड़ा छूने के लिए धनुष को सिर्फ 69.86 crore gross कलेक्शन की जरूरत है। 💥

अगर यह फिल्म बॉक्स ऑफिस पर सफल होती है, तो धनुष post-COVID era में यह मुकाम हासिल करने वाले Rajinikanth, Thalapathy Vijay, Suriya और Chiyaan Vikram के बाद Kollywood के 5th male star बन जाएंगे! 🔥

क्या आपको लगता है कि OM धनुष को 1000 crore club में पहुंचा पाएगी? कमेंट्स में अपनी राय ज़रूर बताएं! 👇

ctx.title: Box Office: Dhanush Eyes 1000 Crore Club Entry With OM, Aims To Become Kollywood’s 5th Male Star To Achieve The Feat Post-COVID!
ctx.summary:
Dhanush gears up for the release of OM, which is enjoying good buzz and has the potential to score big at the worldwide box office. 
 The post  Box Office: Dhanush Eyes 1000 Crore Club Entry With OM, Aims To Become Kollywood’s 5th Male Star To Achieve The Feat Post-COVID!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
OM is releasing in theaters on November 20, and the stage is all set for its grand arrival. Its promotional assets have been received well, generating good buzz in the pre-release phase. Also, the casting of Mammootty and the association with director Rajkumar Periasamy have helped the film grab eyeballs. So, a big start is guaranteed, and it can also help Dhanush to unleash the 1000 crore milestone at the worldwide box office in the post-COVID era.
In the post-COVID era, the actor has had nine theatrical releases so far, of which five have entered the 100 crore club worldwide. His first release was Thiruchitrambalam, which grossed 117.88 crore . It was followed by Naane Varuvean, which earned 35.52 crore . Vaathi grossed 116.2 crore , followed by Captain Miller at 75.43 crore . Raayan did a business of 155.35 crore , while Kuberaa grossed 138.86 crore . Idli Kadai grossed 72.08 crore . Tere Ishk Mein grossed a solid 164 crore and is currently the actor’s highest-grossing film ever. His previous film, Kara, grossed 54.82 crore .
Overall, the post-COVID total of Dhanush stands at 930.14 crore gross at the worldwide box office. As we can see, he needs only 69.86 crore more to enter the 1000 crore club, a milestone likely to be achieved comfortably, given the strong buzz around OM.
Take a look at the worldwide collection of Dhanush’s post-COVID releases:
With OM , Dhanush is most likely to cross the 1000 crore milestone worldwide. With this, he’ll become the fifth Kollywood male star to achieve the feat in the post-COVID era. So far, Rajinikanth, Thalapathy Vijay, Suriya, and Chiyaan Vikram have entered the 1000 crore club. Now, the Maari star is looking forward to joining them.
